cards.art: Punk raccoon and elegant swan colliding mid-air, sparks flying
cards.lore: Attraction is no accident. It's a collision. Strengths and weaknesses must violently clash to create the narrative spark.
cards.name: The Contrast Collider
cards.power: Force opponent to reveal their character's greatest strength. It instantly triggers your character's worst flaw.

cards.art: Bandaged goat leaning on a limping fox, both holding each other up
cards.lore: You don't complete me, you fix my specific psychological damage. No friction structure? No drama. Just decoration.
cards.name: The Complementary Crutch
cards.power: Attach to a wounded fighter. Their weakness becomes your healing potential, generating +3 Chemistry Tokens.

cards.art: Two wolves with identical scars facing opposite directions
cards.lore: The ultimate resonance point. They suffer the same damage, but developed opposite false survival mechanisms.
cards.name: The Shared Wound
cards.power: Play when both players discard a card. Bind both characters to the exact same past trauma.

cards.art: Two identical golden retrievers in matching outfits, flat smiles, surrounding rubble
cards.lore: Perfection is the enemy of the Love Epic. If they don't challenge each other existentially, tear up the script.
cards.name: The False-Perfect Pair
cards.power: Trap Card. Discard any couple that looks 'perfectly matched' on paper. They take 5 Boredom Damage.

cards.art: Armadillo shedding its shell in open field, completely exposed
cards.lore: The Contemporary Romance thesis. You cannot be loved until you drop the mask. It's an ethical bloodbath. (Architects Daughter)
cards.name: Vulnerability Over Perfection
cards.power: Discard all your Defense shields. Gain the "True Love" win condition.

cards.art: Bear lowering a club, a fox handing back a stolen item
cards.lore: The Second-Chance Mandate. To rebuild trust, you must abandon the safety of your grudges. (Architects Daughter)
cards.name: Forgiveness Over Revenge
cards.power: Cancel an enemy's attack, but you must permanently discard your highest-damage weapon.

cards.art: Chameleon caught mid-color-change, all camouflage failing simultaneously
cards.lore: The RomCom Imperative. The most embarrassing, pants-down moment of one's life becomes their core identity. (Architects Daughter)
cards.name: Authenticity Over Facade
cards.power: Expose all hidden cards in your opponent's hand. The most embarrassing one becomes their core identity.

cards.art: Two lovers running from a crumbling palace, holding hands
cards.lore: Historical and Paranormal law. Individual love over collective expectation. The world burns, the heart beats. (Architects Daughter)
cards.name: Rebellion Over Order
cards.power: Destroy the current Arena. The lovers survive, but society is discarded.

cards.art: Two hamsters on separate treadmills, glancing at each other exhaustedly
cards.name: The Contemporary Grind

cards.art: Pelican slipping on a banana peel, papers flying, another animal watching in mortified attraction
cards.lore: Humor as a valve for the fear of love. Don't use slapstick as decoration—use it to completely expose a character's core flaw.
cards.name: The RomCom Slapstick
cards.power: Convert an opponent's quirky points into Humor tokens.

cards.art: Owl and cat facing opposite walls, STATIC speech bubble between them
cards.lore: No artificial drama! True misunderstandings must grow logically out of the characters' false protection mechanisms.
cards.name: The Big Misunderstanding
cards.power: Block all communication. Can only be resolved by character growth, not a simple text message.

cards.art: Hyena holding a comedic mask as shield, arrows bouncing off, heart locked behind
cards.lore: Jokes are armor. The witty banter isn't just fun, it's a desperate tactic to avoid being truly vulnerable.
cards.name: The Comedy Shield
cards.power: Ignore all Emotional Damage this turn, but your character makes zero progress toward intimacy.

cards.art: Badger in Victorian dress trapped in an ornate gilded cage
cards.lore: Dialogue that sounds ironical but hits modern emotional truth. Societal constraint is the physical architecture of the cage.
cards.name: The Historical Cage
cards.power: Lock a character's actions to 'Society Rules'. They cannot attack directly.

cards.art: Massive wolf deliberately kneeling before a small rabbit, fangs retracted
cards.lore: Power imbalance requires sacrifice. The stronger entity must intentionally weaken themselves, or it's just a power-fantasy, not a romance.
cards.name: The Paranormal Taboo
cards.power: The player with higher Power must voluntarily reduce their stats to zero to allow the romance to progress.

cards.art: Dog and troll holding a cracked vase together, both visibly terrified
cards.lore: The second chance must be more expensive than the first. The characters must risk infinitely more this time.
cards.name: The Second-Chance Cost
cards.power: Resurrect a discarded relationship, but pay double the initial emotional cost.

cards.art: Two shadowy panthers circling each other in a stone dungeon
cards.lore: Sex as a power struggle, healing, or destruction. Morally risky, but legitimate if the trauma is followed to its darkest consequence.
cards.name: The Dark Romance Dungeon
cards.power: Convert Trauma tokens into Attraction. Highly unstable.

cards.art: Regal lion in business suit, heart exposed through chest
cards.lore: Hero: Highly competent externally, totally vulnerable in love. Must learn: "I am enough, even without the mask."
cards.name: The Masked Protagonist
cards.power: High competence in the outer world, zero defense in the love arena.

cards.art: Sheep with a hidden scar, looking directly at a lion off-frame
cards.lore: Complementary perfection. Must have their own wound (fear of commitment, false loyalty) or they are just a prop.
cards.name: The Love Interest
cards.power: Perfectly targets the Protagonist's specific psychological wound.

cards.art: Walrus in expensive suit gesturing to a comfortable sofa, protagonist wavering
cards.lore: The Ex, the Career, the Society. Never a pure villain—they inevitably create the temptation of safety over the terrifying work of true love.
cards.name: The Blocker (The Safe Choice)
cards.power: Tempts the Protagonist with safety. Delays the HEA indefinitely.

cards.art: Wise tortoise holding a mirror to a reluctant rabbit's face
cards.lore: Not just comic relief, the mirror, telling the protagonist the brutal truth they desperately refuse to hear.
cards.name: The Mentor / Truth-Teller
cards.power: Forces a player to read their character's hidden flaw out loud.

cards.art: Two foxes crossing verbal swords, both smirking, neither yielding
cards.lore: Rhetorical sparring. Shows intelligence and attraction simultaneously. A power dynamic where neither side surrenders.
cards.name: The Flirt Duel
cards.power: Both players draw a card. Neither wins completely. Tension increases by +2.

cards.art: Two rams locking horns on a cliff edge, both dignified
cards.lore: The hardest debate to write. Conflict born from colliding, equally legitimate moral values. Nobody is screaming; everyone is bleeding.
cards.name: The Valid Conflict
cards.power: Play when both characters are right. No black-and-white villains allowed.

cards.art: Two animals sitting in silence, watching each other breathe, broken hearts visible
cards.lore: The moment the fight drops. Fewer words, more pauses. The character stops performing and simply is.
cards.name: The Vulnerable Silence
cards.power: Silence all inner monologues. Force characters to rely entirely on physical micro-expressions.

cards.art: Peacock mid-declaration, feathers fully open, opponent visibly disarmed
cards.lore: No clichés! The speech proves one thing: that you have truly, deeply seen the specific damage of the other person.
cards.name: The Grand Gesture Speech
cards.power: Expose the opponent's core wound and instantly heal it with exact, terrifying precision.

cards.art: Badger and squirrel on a seesaw, midpoint of crossing
cards.lore: Erotica rule #1: Show the shift. Dominance to equality to surrender. Physical details are merely tools for emotional truth.
cards.name: The Power Shift
cards.power: Transfer Dominance from one character to the other. Creates new Vulnerability.

cards.art: Rhinoceros charging through a stone wall, exposing a fragile interior
cards.lore: Erotica rule #2: Intimacy as an act of bravery, capitulation, a transgression of limits.
cards.name: The Barrier Breaker
cards.power: Smash one psychological barrier, immediately replace it with a new emotional vulnerability.

cards.art: Hedgehog curled protectively after emerging from another's embrace
cards.lore: Erotica rule #3: Closeness breeds terror. Intimacy inevitably creates the fear of loss. That fear is your next plot point.
cards.name: The Consequence of Closeness
cards.power: After intimacy, generate a massive new internal conflict based on the characters' flaws.

cards.art: Octopus retreating into shadow while trailing glowing ink
cards.lore: Write from vulnerability, not performance. If it's just pornography with a plot, Uncle FrizzleBob disqualifies you.
cards.name: The Erotic Retreat
cards.power: The character gains Distance but takes Healing Damage.

cards.art: Raccoon and cat making coffee in a tiny kitchen, no escape route
cards.lore: The realm of the everyday. No grand ballrooms to hide in, just the terrifying vulnerability of making coffee.
cards.name: The Intimate Kitchen
cards.power: Remove all protective distance. Characters must confront each other's mundane reality.

cards.art: Two characters dancing formally in a grand ballroom, whispering intimately
cards.lore: Architecture as a weapon. The physical space must map the exact tension axis of the relationship.
cards.name: The Palace of Contrasts
cards.power: Pit public expectation directly against private desire.

cards.art: Lizard on hot pavement mid-argument with iguana
cards.lore: Spring is hope, winter is isolation, fall is maturity. Summer is pure, suffocating escalation. The weather is your feelings.
cards.name: Seasonal Overheating
cards.power: Apply "Summer" modifier: Maximum intensity, zero patience.

cards.art: Koala navigating labyrinthine stone stairs with locked doors
cards.lore: In Historical and Gothic, the house is the enemy. The social rules are built directly into the bricks.
cards.name: Architectural Constraints
cards.power: Manifest societal constraints as literal, impassable geography.

cards.art: Badger and raccoon colliding at a crossroads, grocery bags exploding
cards.lore: Not just cute—fated. This encounter MUST force this specific character to face this specific opponent.
cards.name: ACT I: THE MEET-CUTE COLLISION
cards.power: Trigger an inevitable encounter that exploits both characters' core flaws simultaneously.

cards.art: Frog at a crossroads in rain, looking at a crumbling bridge
cards.lore: The midpoint shift. The realization that continuing this relationship will require destroying their old identity.
cards.name: BLACK MOMENT I: THE DOUBT
cards.power: Force the characters to question if the emotional risk is worth the inevitable pain.

cards.art: All the gathered pieces of a life scattered in rubble
cards.lore: The darkest hour. The false protection mechanism falls catastrophically. The trauma is real, and the loss feels permanent.
cards.name: BLACK MOMENT II: THE RUIN
cards.power: Reactivate the original trauma. The false protection mechanism falls catastrophically.

cards.art: Frog carrying a lamp into the other character's darkness — no roses, just light
cards.lore: Anti-Cliché Rule: Help instead of a speech. Heal the exact wound, nothing else.
cards.name: THE GRAND GESTURE ACTION
cards.power: Sacrifice your ego to provide exactly what the other character needs, not what they want.

cards.art: Two scarred animals standing together on a summit, wounds visible, smiling
cards.lore: A Happy Ending isn't given, it's extracted from your flaws. It is the dramaturgical reward for learning vulnerability.
cards.name: The Earned HEA (Happily Ever After)
cards.power: Win the game. Can only be played if both core flaws have been actively sacrificed.

cards.art: Two animals sharing a warm meal, storm clouds gathering outside
cards.lore: Equally valid as an HEA. It doesn't have to be eternal. It just has to be morally earned in this specific moment.
cards.name: The HFN (Happy For Now)
cards.power: A temporary victory. You succeed today, but the future remains uncertain.

cards.art: Peacock stripping his feathers in a crowded plaza to defend a sparrow
cards.lore: The external proof of change. The final barricade falls. Of your pride and the person. Pick one.
cards.name: The Public Sacrifice
cards.power: Destroy your public reputation to prove your private loyalty.

cards.art: Wolf whispering into another's ear in a dark tunnel, both exhaling
cards.lore: The internal proof of change. The final barricade falls. The lie is dead, long live the terrifying truth.
cards.name: The Private Confession
cards.power: Reveal the ultimate truth. Healing begins, but shields are gone forever.

cards.art: Robot and person bumping into each other generically, referee throwing red flag
cards.lore: Slop symptom: The encounter is cute but arbitrary. Cure: Derive the meeting entirely from the characters' core flaws.
cards.name: The Cliché Meet-Cute
cards.power: TRAP! If a meeting could happen to anyone, it means nothing. Discard encounter.

cards.art: Referee blowing whistle as two animals kiss, clipboard showing unresolved issues
cards.lore: Slop symptom: A physical act resolves a conflict that didn't earn a resolution. Cure: Every solution must cost something.
cards.name: Magical Redemption
cards.power: TRAP! A kiss does not fix systemic psychological damage.

cards.art: Two identical sheep holding hands and snoring simultaneously
cards.lore: Slop symptom: Both are too competent, too kind, too agreeable. Cure: Build the Love Map and mash their trigger points!
cards.name: The Frictionless Pair
cards.power: TRAP! Zero conflict means zero story. Both players fall asleep.

cards.art: 2D cardboard cutout villain with 'RIVAL' label, protagonist sees through it
cards.lore: Slop symptom: The Ex is purely a villain. Cure: The third party needs their own logic and legitimacy, or the choice has no weight.
cards.name: The 1D Blocker
cards.power: TRAP! If the rival is just there to cause jealousy, the tension is fake.

cards.art: Bear holding roses at a first date being shown the door
cards.lore: Slop symptom: The declaration is too big, too soon. Cure: Emotional escalation in microscopic steps. Save the speech for the climax.
cards.name: The Unearned "Always Loved You"
cards.power: TRAP! Playing the grand declaration before doing the emotional labor causes instant failure.

cards.art: Ostrich refusing to look up, holding a phone, obvious solution ignored
cards.lore: Slop symptom: Artificial silence. Cure: They cannot communicate because they don't know themselves yet, not because they dropped their phone.
cards.name: The Stupid Misunderstanding
cards.power: TRAP! If the conflict can be solved with one normal sentence, it's garbage.

cards.art: Cat wearing trauma as decorative necklace, referee writing ticket
cards.lore: Slop symptom: Trauma as romantic backstory jewelry. Cure: The wound MUST be actively weaponized against them at Black Moment 2.
cards.name: Decorative Trauma
cards.power: TRAP! Mentioning a dark past once and forgetting it is a storytelling felony.

cards.art: Gorgeous sunset backdrop with crossed-out sign, two animals with unhealthy dynamics
cards.lore: Stop substituting sunsets for psychological depth!! Every location must reflect the relationship dynamic, or it gets deleted.
cards.name: The Stockholm Sunset Slop
cards.power: TRAP! Pretty scenery does not excuse toxic, unexamined power dynamics.

cards.art: Two birds pulling a rubber band between them, trembling
cards.lore: The pull between what they desperately want and what they are terrified to ask for.
cards.name: Tension (The Rubber Band)
cards.power: Fuel the engine with broken expectations, silence, and misread signals.

cards.art: Character on a scale, love on one side, the abyss on the other
cards.lore: If they fail, they don't just stay single. They are condemned to live forever within their own fatal flaw.
cards.name: Stakes (The Abyss)
cards.power: The wager is everything. Win love, or permanently lose the self.

cards.art: Wolf turning armor inside-out, soft lining exposed, glowing
cards.lore: The paradigm shift. The realization that exposing the soft underbelly is the only true show of strength.
cards.name: Revelation (The Unmasking)
cards.power: Flip the paradigm. Expose that vulnerability is the ultimate armor.

cards.art: Cat and dog magnetically drawn together against visible warning signs
cards.lore: The cosmic joke. They are drawn to the exact person engineered to destroy their carefully curated bullshit.
cards.name: Irony Potential
cards.power: Multiply attraction by the exact factor of their absolute incompatibility.

cards.art: Two small beetles beneath a galaxy, reaching toward each other
cards.lore: The Love Epic. Two individuals reflecting the universal mythic hunger for connection against the void.
cards.name: Mythic Gravity
cards.power: Elevate the relationship from a personal crush to a universal human thesis.

cards.art: Two cracked vessels fitting together perfectly, light pouring through the joins
cards.lore: Neither is whole alone. Their specific weaknesses interlock to create a structure stronger than perfection.
cards.name: The Two-Weakness Principle
cards.power: Combine two broken things to create an unbreakable structure.

cards.art: Armored creature standing free, shed shell behind it, partner beside
cards.lore: The question was never "Will they get together?" It was always "Can they mutate enough to survive the connection?"
cards.name: The Core Flaw Overcome
cards.power: Transformation achieved. The character can finally exist without their armor.

cards.art: Two silhouettes without costumes, standing in light, revealed
cards.lore: Truby's logic fulfilled: Moral Revelation → Moral Choice → Consequence. The Happy Ending is the ultimate moral laboratory.
cards.name: Moral Revelation
cards.power: The match ends. The Kayfabe drops. The truth emerges.
